shots.name: Manual Plunger
shots.notes: A normal plunge sends the ball toward the Green Machine rollovers. The skill shot is a much harder plunge straight into the Hill entrance.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Fitted with a kickback that usually returns the ball into the bumper area. The Bumper Saucer relights it.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Lights Double Lap on the ramp and makes the right spinner worth 3,000 a spin instead of 1,000.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Lights the left spinner for 3,000 a spin.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Lights your bonus. This side has no kickback and metal guides, so it drains harder than the left.

shots.name: Left Slingshot Kicker
shots.notes: An unusual slingshot with a kicker along its top edge that fires the ball vertically, usually toward the captive ball and sometimes right into the Hill entrance.

shots.name: 1-Lap Targets
shots.notes: Two of them, one near the ramp exit on the left and one right of the ramp. They light after each trip to the Hill, and hitting either turns both off. Both are risky shots.

shots.name: Race Blue Beard Targets
shots.notes: Three standups on the left. Completing the bank challenges Blue Beard and lights him on the Hill.

shots.name: Race Red Hot Targets
shots.notes: Three more standups just above Blue Beard's. Completing them challenges Red Hot.

shots.name: Lower Captive Ball
shots.notes: Worth 10,000, then 25,000 at four laps and 50,000 from seven laps on. It can also carry an extra ball. Safe, easy and steadily profitable once your lap count is up.

shots.name: Left Spinner
shots.notes: 1,000 a spin, or 3,000 when the right inlane has lit it. Shooting through here leads to the Hill entrance.

shots.name: Hill Entrance
shots.notes: Through the left spinner. If the Hill is lit, a magnet carries the ball up to the upper playfield. If not, it kicks out toward the Green Machine rollovers.

shots.name: Race Green Machine Rollovers
shots.notes: Three rollovers across the top. The left two drop into the bumpers, the right one is walled off and feeds the upper right flipper. Complete all three to challenge Green Machine, and rotate them with the flipper buttons.

shots.name: Bumper Saucer
shots.notes: Sits inside the bumper nest, and it is also reachable head-on through the gap in the Yellow Belly targets. Spots an opponent target, lights the kickback, fires Freestyle, and becomes the Time Lock during multiball.

shots.name: Race Yellow Belly Targets
shots.notes: Three standups in the middle of the playfield. The gap between the left pair and the right one is the mouth of the Bumper Saucer.

shots.name: The Ramp
shots.notes: Shot from the left flipper, runs around the back of the playfield and drops quickly toward the right flipper. Worth one lap normally and two after the left inlane or during multiball. A ball returning from the Hill comes down here but scores no lap.

shots.name: Right Spinner
shots.notes: 1,000 a spin, 3,000 when lit by the left inlane. A firm shot pushes past a one-way gate up to the top rollovers, and a really hard one carries all the way to the Hill entrance.

shots.name: Upper Right Flipper
shots.notes: Full-length flipper fed by the right Green Machine rollover. Used to pick off standup banks and the captive ball.

shots.name: Center Post
shots.notes: Rises between the Hill's two flippers and covers the drains up there — the upper playfield has no inlanes or outlanes, so the post is the only thing between you and a drain. The lamps and sound effect count its remaining time down.

shots.name: Hill: Yellow Belly Loop
shots.notes: A loop on the left of the upper playfield. Just tripping the entrance is enough to count. Passing a lit opponent pays 50,000.

shots.name: Hill: Blue Beard Loop
shots.notes: The mirror loop on the right. Looping it and then holding up the right flipper is a clean way to reach the Green Machine target.

shots.name: Hill: Green Machine Target
shots.notes: A standup in the middle of the upper playfield, reachable from either flipper up there.

shots.name: Hill: A-B-C Targets
shots.notes: The A sits inside the Yellow Belly loop, the B and C inside the Blue Beard loop. Completing all three extends the centre post timer and doubles the Cycle Jump for this trip only.

shots.name: Hill: Red Hot
shots.notes: You will find this hole at the Hill's upper left. It passes Red Hot when that is lit, scores the Cycle Jump, and drops the ball back down to the lower playfield. Miss it and the ball usually settles in the drain hole alongside.

shots.name: Hill: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Spots one lap in normal play and is the jackpot shot against the King of the Hill during multiball.

shots.name: Hill: Lock Shot
shots.notes: Right of the Yellow Belly loop. Locks the ball for multiball when lit; otherwise it kicks the ball up toward the Red Hot area and the tiny upper left flipper.

goals.title: Cycle Stunt Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge straight into the Hill entrance. It pays 100,000 the first time and climbs by 100,000 each time to a ceiling of 500,000, and it does more than score — it advances your race position and sends you straight up to the Hill.

steps.action: Plunge straight into the Hill Entrance
steps.detail: A normal-strength plunge just runs the ball into the Green Machine lanes — aim past them for the Hill Entrance itself. It sends the ball straight up to the Hill and awards whichever of these it can: light an opponent, light all remaining opponents for Freestyle, or spot one for 50,000.

goals.title: Building Laps
goals.summary: Laps are the quiet backbone of the whole game — they set the captive ball value, feed your bonus, and eventually hand you extra balls. You start with one already banked, and the ramp is by far the most efficient way to add more.
goals.reward: Extra ball around eight laps, Finish Line at 25

steps.detail: That lights Double Lap, so the next ramp is worth two instead of one.
One lap normally, two after the inlane or during multiball. This one shot builds bonus, captive ball value and multiball progress at the same time.

steps.action: Take the upper captive ball on every Hill trip
steps.detail: It spots a lap for free while you are up there anyway.
They light after each Hill trip, but they are drain shots and the ramp gives you the same lap far more safely.

goals.title: The Lower Captive Ball
goals.summary: Easy, safe and increasingly valuable. It pays 10,000 to start, 25,000 once you reach four laps and 50,000 from seven laps onward, and it can carry an extra ball as well. Once the ramp has done its work this is one of the best risk-to-reward shots on the machine.

steps.detail: The captive ball value is driven entirely by your lap count.
50,000 a shot with very little risk, and around eight laps it lights an extra ball.
The upper right flipper picks off the captive ball and the standup banks comfortably.

goals.title: Challenging the Four Racers
goals.summary: You start the race in sixth place. Green Machine, Blue Beard, Yellow Belly and Red Hot each have their own bank of three targets on the lower playfield, and completing a bank challenges that racer — which is what lights the Hill.
goals.reward: The Hill lit, and 50,000 per racer passed

steps.detail: Each of the four racers has a bank: Green Machine on the top rollovers, Blue Beard and Red Hot on the left, Yellow Belly through the middle.

steps.action: Let the saucer do the work
steps.detail: The Bumper Saucer spots whichever target most helps you finish a bank. Before your first multiball the ramp spots targets too.

steps.action: Ride up while a racer is challenged
steps.detail: The Hill is only lit while at least one challenged racer is still unpassed.

goals.title: Riding Banzai Hill
goals.summary: The upper playfield is on the backglass and it is steep, so trips up there are short. A magnet carries the ball up and drops it to the left flipper. Passing a racer means hitting that racer's own shot on the Hill.

steps.action: Get up there through the spinner
steps.detail: The left slingshot kicker will sometimes fire you straight in by accident.
Yellow Belly is a loop on the left, Blue Beard a loop on the right, Green Machine a target in the middle and Red Hot a hole in the upper left.

steps.action: Do not clear them all at once
steps.detail: Passing every flashing racer closes the Hill until you challenge someone new down below — leaving one is how you keep the door open.

goals.title: Cycle Jump
goals.summary: The Red Hot hole on the Hill pays a Cycle Jump that starts at 75,000 and climbs 25,000 each time, and the value carries between balls. It is the main reason to ride the Hill even when you have no racer to pass.

steps.action: Shoot Red Hot for the jump
steps.detail: It also drops you back to the lower playfield, so it ends the trip.
Completing A, B and C doubles the Cycle Jump — but only for the current trip, and the stored value itself never doubles.
Shooting only for Cycle Jumps until several racers are challenged is worth more than passing them one at a time.

goals.title: The A-B-C Targets
goals.summary: The A sits inside the Yellow Belly loop and the B and C inside the Blue Beard loop. Completing them buys you two things at once: extra time on the centre post down below, and a doubled Cycle Jump for the rest of this Hill trip.

steps.action: Pick up the A on the left loop
steps.detail: It is inside the loop, so a clean loop shot usually collects it on the way through.

steps.action: Take B and C on the right
steps.detail: Both sit inside the Blue Beard loop.
During multiball, A-B-C plus the Hill captive ball on the same trip is worth a million and an extra ball.

goals.title: The Bumper Saucer
goals.summary: The busiest hole on the playfield. It spots opponent targets, relights the left outlane kickback, fires the Freestyle playfield, acts as the Time Lock during multiball, and restarts multiball. If you are not sure what to shoot, shoot this.

steps.detail: You do not have to be in the bumpers — there is a head-on route through the gap in the Yellow Belly targets.
The target it spots is always the one that best advances a racer bank you are close to finishing.
This is the only thing that relights it, and the left outlane is otherwise a plain drain.

goals.title: Light the Spinners
goals.summary: Both spinners pay 1,000 a spin on their own and 3,000 when lit, and the inlanes cross-light them — the left inlane lights the right spinner and the right inlane lights the left. Small money, but it costs nothing to collect on the way past.

steps.detail: Right inlane lights the left spinner, left inlane lights the right one.
A firm shot here reaches the top rollovers, and a really hard one carries all the way to the Hill entrance.

steps.action: Use the left one as a Hill feed
steps.detail: The Hill entrance sits behind it, so this shot does double duty.

goals.title: The Top Rollovers
goals.summary: Three rollovers across the top challenge Green Machine when completed, and the flipper buttons rotate which are lit. The right one is walled off from the other two and feeds the upper right flipper, which is a useful place to be.

steps.action: Rotate the lights as the ball travels
steps.detail: Either flipper button moves them, so completions are mostly free if you are paying attention.
It skips the bumpers and hands you a controlled ball on the upper flipper.

goals.title: The Center Post
goals.summary: Up on the Hill a post rises between the upper flippers and covers the drains until its timer runs out. That matters more than it sounds: the Hill has no inlanes or outlanes at all, so this post is your only protection while you are up there. Completing A-B-C buys more of it.

steps.detail: Completing all three adds to the post timer.

steps.action: Know what it does not cover
steps.detail: It covers the Hill's drains, but a ball dropping out of the Red Hot area is outside its protection and returns to the lower playfield.

goals.title: Freestyle
goals.summary: Once all four racers have been challenged, the target banks reset and a second completion lights that racer on a hidden mini-playfield on the backglass. A ball is then fired across eight targets, and if it hits a lit one that racer is passed for free.

steps.action: Complete a bank for the second time
steps.detail: After all four have been challenged once, completions light Freestyle targets instead of challenging again.

steps.action: Fire it from the saucer or the Hill
steps.detail: Any shot to the Hill or the Bumper Saucer kicks the Freestyle ball out.

steps.action: Do not build a plan around it
steps.detail: It is entirely a chance shot, and passing racers yourself on the Hill is faster. Complete a bank a third time and the completion passes the racer outright.

goals.title: Locking for Multiball
goals.summary: Defeat all four racers and the Lock Shot on the Hill lights immediately — so if the last racer you beat is up there already, you can lock without another trip. Otherwise the game will nag you back up the Hill.
goals.reward: Two-ball play and a shot at the King

steps.action: Beat Red Hot early, not last
steps.detail: Red Hot ejects you back down to the lower playfield, so finishing on it throws you off the Hill just as the Lock lights. Take Red Hot early and leave one of the lower three racers for last, and the Lock is lit while you are still up there — saving a whole trip.
The second ball goes to the manual plunger, and the skill shot is still available there for the points.
The ramp is lit for a double lap for the whole of multiball.

goals.title: The King of the Hill
goals.summary: The fifth and final racer, and the whole point of the game. Put a ball in the Bumper Saucer to start the Time Lock, then get up the Hill and hit the captive ball inside about twenty seconds. The clock pauses while you are actually on the Hill.
goals.reward: 1 million, or 1 million plus an extra ball

steps.detail: One of your two balls has to go in here first — the saucer flashes Time Lock throughout multiball.
Time stops whenever a ball is up top, so a failed trip normally leaves room for two or three more attempts.
One million and the race is won.

steps.action: Take A-B-C on the same trip for the extra ball
steps.detail: Collecting A-B-C and then the captive ball on one trip pays the million plus an extra ball.

goals.title: Victory Laps
goals.summary: Once the King is beaten, the ramp is lit for the rest of multiball for two laps and a 250,000 Victory Lap. There is no cap on how many you can collect, so this is where a good Banzai Run score actually comes from.

steps.detail: Victory Laps only exist after the King is down.
Two laps and 250,000 every time, for as long as you keep two balls alive.

goals.title: Your Bonus, Calculated Openly
goals.summary: There is no mystery number and no bonus multiplier here. Your bonus is 10,000 for every lap plus 20,000 for every racer you have defeated, which means every lap and every pass you make is money you can count while you play.
instructions: Laps carry from ball to ball until you hit 25 for Finish Line, which pays 750,000 and an extra ball and then resets the count.
The extra ball at roughly eight laps is only offered on the first pass — after Finish Line resets you, it does not come back.
Defeated racers carry between balls until you have played multiball, then reset afterwards.
Racers beaten before that multiball still count toward the bonus for that ball, which is why they move to the Prior Race section of the standings rather than disappearing.
There is no bonus multiplier at all, so nothing you do late in a ball inflates what you already earned.

goals.title: When the Hill Is Closed
goals.summary: If the magnet that carries balls up to the Hill is not working, the game compensates rather than dying. Every shot to the Hill entrance does the job the upper playfield would have done, one step at a time.
instructions: Each Hill entrance shot spots one challenged racer, so you can still work through all four from the lower playfield.
A Hill entrance shot also locks the ball for multiball when the lock is lit.
During multiball, a Hill entrance shot defeats the King of the Hill.
You lose the Cycle Jump, the A-B-C doubler and everything else that only exists up top, so scores will be much lower — but the game is still finishable.

achievements.title: Cycle Stunt
achievements.desc: Plunge straight into the Hill entrance for the skill shot.

achievements.title: Up The Wall
achievements.desc: Ride the magnet up to Banzai Hill for the first time.

achievements.title: What A Move
achievements.desc: Challenge a racer down below and pass them on the Hill.

achievements.title: Fifty Thousand A Shot
achievements.desc: Build to seven laps so the lower captive ball pays its maximum.

achievements.title: A-B-C
achievements.desc: Complete all three A-B-C targets on one trip up the Hill.

achievements.title: Big Air
achievements.desc: Double a Cycle Jump with A-B-C before collecting it at Red Hot.

achievements.title: All Four Down
achievements.desc: Defeat all four racers and lock a ball on the Hill.

achievements.title: King Of The Hill
achievements.desc: Beat the King with the Hill captive ball during multiball.

achievements.title: Victory Lap
achievements.desc: Collect a 250,000 Victory Lap after beating the King.

achievements.title: Finish Line
achievements.desc: Accumulate 25 laps for 750,000 and an extra ball.

drills.title: Plunge Past The Lanes
drills.text: A normal plunge runs the ball into the Green Machine lanes; the skill shot is a harder one that carries all the way into the Hill entrance. Work the extra pull until the ball goes past the lanes and up the Hill instead of dropping into them.

drills.title: Double-Lap Ramp Reps
drills.text: Roll the left inlane, then take the ramp so it counts two laps instead of one. One shot builds bonus, captive ball value and multiball progress at the same time, so this is the shot to own before anything else.

drills.title: Bumper Saucer, Head-On
drills.text: Shoot the Bumper Saucer straight through the gap in the Yellow Belly targets rather than waiting for the bumpers to drop a ball in for you. It spots opponent targets and relights the left outlane kickback, so a reliable head-on route pays for itself all game.

drills.title: Catch The Hill Arrival
drills.text: Ride the Hill entrance and the magnet drops you onto the Hill's left flipper, where there are no inlanes or outlanes at all — only the centre post. Catch that drop before you shoot anything and use the post's countdown to decide how many shots you actually have.

drills.title: A-B-C, Then Red Hot
drills.text: On every Hill trip take the A inside the left loop and the B and C inside the right loop before you go anywhere near Red Hot. Red Hot pays the Cycle Jump and drops you back down, so shooting it early throws away the doubled value you just built.

drills.title: Spinner Into The Hill
drills.text: Roll the right inlane to light the left spinner, then rip the left spinner so the ball carries on into the Hill entrance behind it. You collect 3,000 a spin on the way to the shot you wanted anyway.

actionButton.how: No extra button on the cabinet. A manual plunger, two flipper buttons and nudging cover everything — including the vertical Hill playfield up on the backbox, whose flippers run off the same two buttons you are already holding. Those buttons also rotate the lit Green Machine rollovers across the top.

howItPlays.objective: Banzai Run is a Williams motocross racer with a second, fully vertical playfield mounted up on the backbox. The race opens with you down in sixth: challenge the four rivals on the lower deck, pass each one up on the Hill, then beat the King of the Hill for a million.
loop: Complete a rival's bank of three targets down below to challenge that racer, which lights the Hill.
Fire through the left spinner into the Hill entrance; a magnet hauls the ball up to the vertical playfield and drops it on the upper-left flipper.
Pass the racer you challenged by hitting that racer's own shot up on the Hill, worth fifty thousand each.
Bank laps on the ramp -- one normally, two after the left inlane -- to grow your bonus, the captive-ball value and multiball progress from a single shot.
Beat all four rivals to light the Lock, then win King of the Hill at the upper captive ball for the million, and cash Victory Laps for the rest of multiball.

lights.name: Green Machine Rollovers
lights.lit: The three rollovers across the top are the Green Machine racer's bank and a lit one still needs rolling, while the right rollover is fenced away from its two neighbors and drops onto the upper-right flipper for a controlled ball.

control.effect: either flipper button rotates which of the three rollovers are lit
control.when: as the ball travels across the top lanes

lights.then: Rotate the lit ones so the ball rolls the lanes you still need, and complete all three to challenge the Green Machine, the fourth racer, lighting him up on the Hill. Because either button moves them as the ball rolls, the set is often free if you stay alert.

lights.name: Racer Target Banks
lights.lit: Blue Beard and Red Hot each have a three-standup bank on the left and Yellow Belly's runs through the middle with the Bumper Saucer's mouth in the gap, and clearing a bank challenges that rival and lights the Hill until you finish it.
lights.then: The Hill only stays open while a challenged rival is still unpassed, so line up a challenge before every trip. Once all four have been challenged once, a second completion instead lights that rival on the hidden Freestyle playfield, and a third passes him outright.

lights.name: Laps & The Ramp
lights.lit: Your lap count is the quiet engine of the whole game -- it sets the captive-ball value, feeds your bonus, and hands out extra balls -- with one already banked at the start and the total climbing as you add more.
lights.then: Roll the left inlane to light Double Lap, then take the ramp for two at once, and the lower captive ball pays ten thousand, twenty-five at four laps, and fifty from seven on while able to carry an extra ball. An extra ball lights around eight laps, and twenty-five banks Finish Line for seven hundred fifty thousand plus a ball before the count resets.

lights.name: Banzai Hill Racers
lights.lit: Up on the steep vertical playfield each challenged rival flashes at their own shot -- Yellow Belly the left loop, Blue Beard the right loop, Green Machine the center target, Red Hot the upper-left hole -- and hitting a flashing rival's shot passes him for fifty thousand.
lights.then: Do not clear every flashing rival at once, since passing them all shuts the Hill until you challenge someone new below, so leave one to keep the door open. There are no inlanes or outlanes up here and a center post is your only cover, and it counts down, so decide how many shots you have before taking them.

lights.name: Cycle Jump & A-B-C
lights.lit: The Red Hot hole pays the Cycle Jump, which opens at seventy-five thousand and grows twenty-five thousand a time with its stored value carried between balls, while the A hides inside the left loop, with B and C tucked into the right.
lights.then: Grab A, B and C before Red Hot on any trip, since completing them doubles the Cycle Jump for that trip and extends the center post, whereas Red Hot also drops you off the Hill so shooting it early throws the doubler away. Holding rivals back and taking only Cycle Jumps until several are challenged pays more than passing them one by one.

lights.name: The Bumper Saucer
lights.lit: The busiest hole on the lower playfield sits in the bumper nest, though you can also reach it straight-on through the split in the Yellow Belly bank, and it spots whichever rival target best advances a bank you are near finishing.
lights.then: It also relights the left-outlane kickback -- the only thing that does -- fires the Freestyle ball, and becomes the Time Lock during multiball. When you are unsure what to shoot, shoot this.

lights.name: Lock & King of the Hill
lights.lit: Beat all four rivals and the Lock lights at once up on the Hill -- if the last one you passed is already up there you can lock without another trip -- and the locked ball goes to the plunger, where the skill shot is still on offer.
lights.then: In the two-ball play, drop a ball into the Bumper Saucer first to trigger the Time Lock, ride the Hill, and hit the upper captive ball within about twenty seconds, as the clock pauses whenever a ball is up top. That wins the King for a million -- or a million and an extra ball if A-B-C falls on that same trip -- after which the ramp stays lit all multiball for two laps and an uncapped two-hundred-fifty-thousand Victory Lap.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Either flipper button rotates which of the three Green Machine rollovers across the top are lit; tap as the ball rolls the lanes so it covers the ones you have not caught yet. Rolling all three challenges the Green Machine -- one of the four racers you must beat to light the Lock and reach King of the Hill -- and the walled-off right lane also feeds a controlled ball to the upper-right flipper.

scoring.text: Play the safe money first. Build laps on the ramp -- rolling the left inlane first makes it a double -- then farm the lower captive ball, and cross-light the spinners from the inlanes for three thousand a spin on the way past.

Challenge the four rivals below and pass them up on the Hill, but hold some back and stack climbing Cycle Jumps rather than passing them one at a time. Lean on the Bumper Saucer to spot targets and keep the kickback alive.

Defeat all four to light the Lock, start the two-ball multiball, and beat the King of the Hill at the upper captive ball for a million -- a million and an extra ball if A-B-C falls on the same trip. Then live on the lit ramp for uncapped two-hundred-fifty-thousand Victory Laps, which is where a big Banzai Run score actually comes from.
